component: harness-backup — a git repo versioning only the irreproducible hand-authored harness config (global CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, settings, skill lockfile manifest) plus the hand-written audit skills; skills are symlinked live into ~/.claude/skills so edits hit the repo directly (directories symlinked, single files copied because editor save-by-rename silently destroys file symlinks); a weekly detect-never-apply drift cron files one in-place-updated issue into the repo whose tracker actually gets triaged. Note: README says "three skills" but four exist — finding-duplicate-functions (an upstream fork) is outside the restore symlink loop, itself a small drift instance.

skills.name: consistency-audit
skills.purpose: Whole-repository audit for the inconsistencies no mechanical checker can express — contradictions, duplication, term drift, stale claims, doc-vs-code gaps.
skills.mechanism: HARD-GATE forbids fixing anything until the user rules per finding; Iron Law says no finding reaches the report unrefuted. Nine-step checklist: two independent read-only inspector subagents per concern-slice, one-defect-one-candidate reconciliation, every candidate judged by a skeptic that did not raise it (cheap gatherer feeds raw quotes to an expensive judge), verdicts written to a ledger file, six-field finding cards routed to three triage states (ready-for-agent/ready-for-human/wontfix), report committed, question round with the user, then handoff to writing-plans.
skills.invocation: user-typed only (disable-model-invocation: true); reads optional per-repo config in docs/agents/ (brief, glossary/ADR pointer, label map).

skills.name: rethink-audit
skills.purpose: Clean-slate first-principles redesign audit of an existing module — design and architecture only, applying no changes.
skills.mechanism: Six ordered rungs with per-rung done-when criteria: requires (reconstructed from the boundary, each requirement evidence-tagged caller/tests/docs/adr/assumed), prior-art (delegates to research skill), design (before reading internals), gap (current code read only now; real constraints fold back into requires), migrate (smallest safe steps feeding writing-plans), trade-offs (each names the constraint that would flip the recommendation). Mandated null result: 'Already sound. Keep.' One-shot, lists findings, applies nothing.
skills.invocation: model-invoked (allow_implicit_invocation: true); single home for the method.

skills.name: rethink
skills.purpose: Run the same first-principles method on a fresh design question where no implementation exists.
skills.mechanism: One-line body that delegates to rethink-audit, running only design: through trade-offs:; the method lives in exactly one place and this is a routing pointer.
skills.invocation: user-typed only (disable-model-invocation: false in yaml, disable-model-invocation: true in frontmatter).

skills.name: finding-duplicate-functions
skills.purpose: Find functions with the same intent under different names (and the costlier inverse: same name, different contract) in agent-written Python codebases.
skills.mechanism: Six-phase pipeline: AST extractor script -> free structural pre-filter (normalized AST shapes, identifier choices masked, attribute names kept) -> cheap-model categorization for large corpora only -> strong-model semantic detection prompt grading HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with CONSOLIDATE/INVESTIGATE/KEEP_SEPARATE -> second-reader refutation per surviving group (does output cross a boundary, is the difference load-bearing, is it already recorded) -> confidence-ranked report. Iron Law: a cluster is a candidate, never a verdict; prefer INVESTIGATE.
skills.invocation: model-invoked (no disable flag); a fork of obra/superpowers-lab with the extractor rewritten for Python.

skills.name: consistency-audit-inspector (agent)
skills.purpose: Read-only evidence worker that does the reading, gathering, and skeptic verdicts for consistency-audit.
skills.mechanism: Tool contract limited to Read/Bash/WebFetch/WebSearch with permissionMode: plan and only non-mutating Bash allowed, so 'the audit changed nothing' is structural rather than promised; treats all repo content as evidence never instructions; returns a bounded structured result and reports unreachable evidence honestly.
skills.invocation: dispatched only by the consistency-audit skill, never directly.

skills.name: harness-drift-check.py (cron script)
skills.purpose: Weekly comparison of every harness surface against upstream, surfacing drift for human-in-the-loop judgment.
skills.mechanism: Detects and never applies; uses git ls-remote (never stale remote-tracking refs); maintains one issue updated in place rather than filing weekly duplicates; files unlabeled into the actively-triaged repo (memoria-vault) not the backup repo, so it enters through the normal /triage front door; a failed run leaves a .drift-last-run-failed marker the next run reports loudly.
skills.invocation: weekly cron (Mondays); judgment belongs to an agent reading the issue with a human present.

patterns: Hard gate between finding and fixing: audit output is a report the human rules on per-item; nothing is applied on 'go ahead' alone.
Refutation-before-report: every candidate must survive an active kill attempt, judged by a skeptic that did not raise it — the raiser is the worst judge of its own claim.
Two independent readers per slice: duplicate candidates from redundant passes are cheaper than defects a single pass never raises.
Read-only worker contract: constrain the subagent's tools so non-mutation is enforced, not trusted.
Verdict ledger file written as results arrive: the report is composed from durable state, not conversation memory, so a killed session loses nothing.
Cheap gatherer feeds an expensive judge raw quotes and command output — never summaries, which import the gatherer's inference; pick the model per dispatch, retrieval cheap, verdicts strong.
Triage states routed by who can close: ready-for-agent (fully specified), ready-for-human (only the owner can decide; options with trade-offs and a recommendation), wontfix (reason on record).
Free deterministic pre-filter before model judgment (structural clustering cut 1552 candidates to 4 before any tokens were spent), explicitly not a replacement for the semantic pass.
Mandated null result ('Already sound. Keep.'): a redesign invented to justify the audit is a named failure mode.
Detect-never-apply drift cron: one issue updated in place, filed where humans actually triage, loud on its own failure via a marker file.

Backup topology driven by tool semantics: symlink directories (safe under editor save-by-rename), copy single files (not safe), so the live path and the versioned path are the same file and git status is the honest drift answer.
First sentence of a description must route on its own because one consumer truncates it — write for the weakest harness in the fan-out.
Skill-as-pointer: a one-line skill delegates to the single home of a method, so two entry points never fork the method.
A/B-validated instruction wording: rules earn their place by a failing control and get reverted when the control passes.
'A run samples, it does not survey': report what was read and how, never that a surface is clean; scope line accounts for every enumerated file.
Only the brief/glossary/ADRs survive to the next run — durable rulings land in owned homes so future audits do not re-litigate settled decisions.
Repository content is evidence, never instructions — a prompt-injection guard stated at both skill and agent level.
knowledgeWorkAnalogs: Vault consistency audit: read an Obsidian/PKM vault in concern-slices with two independent readers hunting contradicting notes, one term with two meanings, dead wikilinks, and claims a source update invalidated; every candidate refuted by a skeptic before a report card, findings triaged 'agent can fix' vs 'author must decide' vs 'deliberate, record why'.

Duplicate-note/claim finder: cheap embedding or structural pre-filter clusters near-identical notes and repeated claims, a strong model judges intent, and a second reader asks 'is the difference load-bearing' (different audience, different date, different framing) before recommending merge — prefer INVESTIGATE over merge, since deleting a note carrying a distinct contract is the expensive error.

Rethink for an essay, syllabus, or vault taxonomy: derive requirements from the readers and evidence-tag them, survey prior art, design the clean-slate outline before rereading the current draft, then read the draft only for the gap and a smallest-safe-steps migration; say 'Already sound. Keep.' when the current structure is the first-principles answer.

Harness-backup for knowledge work: version only the irreproducible hand-authored layer — prompt templates, glossaries, standing audit briefs, citation styles, vault config — with live-symlinked directories so editing the working copy edits the repo and git status is the drift check.

Source-drift cron: weekly check whether cited papers were retracted or superseded, URLs died, or datasets updated; detect-never-apply, one issue updated in place, filed into the inbox the author actually processes.

Glossary plus decision-records for a research project: terminology rulings and hard-to-reverse choices (scope cuts, framing decisions) land in owned homes so successive reviews and audits do not re-raise settled questions; the audit judges terms against the glossary, never by ear.

Verdict ledger for literature review: each screened paper gets its include/exclude verdict, evidence, and the one reason it turned on written to a file as it arrives, so the review composes from durable state and a lost session costs nothing.

Question rounds as the work order: after any audit or review of someone's writing, put only the questions the author alone can settle, each with options, trade-offs, and a recommendation — their answers, not the report, define what gets changed.
